name: The Scroll of Truth
look: A four-panel comic in a 2x2 grid. A green explorer in a brown wide-brimmed hat opens a chest in a crystal cave, joyfully holds up a glowing scroll, shows the scroll's blank face, then angrily hurls it away beside a stormy sea.
text: I'VE FINALLY FOUND IT... AFTER 15 YEARS
use: The blank scroll holds an uncomfortable truth, and the explorer, who searched for years to find it, throws it away in disgust because he does not want to hear it.
slots: the uncomfortable truth (on the open scroll, third panel)
examples: You can't fix your sleep schedule by staying up late to fix it
The quick question is never quick
describe: comic guy finds a scroll in a cave then throws it away
explorer reads a truth on a scroll and tosses it angrily
four panel comic about finding something after 15 years
green man in a hat opens a treasure chest and finds a glowing scroll
cartoon adventurer rejects an uncomfortable truth he searched for
origin: A four-panel webcomic signed Robotatertot Comics.
